title: Finite-cover unit kills a finite constant pushforward class on a closed subscheme
statement: Let $X$ be an affine scheme [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $f:Y\to X$ finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], and $i:Z\to X$ a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring and $M$ a finite $\Lambda$-module. Let $E=\underline M$ be the constant module sheaf on $Y$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and $U$ the forgetful functor to abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. For $q>0$ and $x\in H^q(Z,i^{-1}U(f_*E))$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-direct-image], there exist a scheme $Y\prime$ and a finite surjective locally finitely presented morphism $\pi:Y\prime\to Y$ [def-weil-surjective-morphism] with $H^q(i^{-1}U(f_*\eta_{\pi,E}))(x)=0$. Here $\eta_{\pi,E}:E\to\pi_*\pi^{-1}E$ is the module-sheaf adjunction unit. No constructibility of the target sheaf is assumed.

source.place: Tag 09ZE, lemma-efface-cohomology-on-closed-by-finite-cover, constructible finite-pushforward paragraph; Tags 0959 and 09ZD (2)

proof.text: Let E be the constant module sheaf M on Y and G its underlying abelian sheaf. Y is affine since f is finite and X affine. Form YZ = Y times_X Z; iY:YZ to Y is a closed immersion. Forgetting coefficients commutes definitionally with direct image. constantCommuteCompose followed by upperStarConstantSheafIso identifies iY inverse image of G with the constant underlying abelian group of M.

Apply finite exchange and the finite-pushforward edge map to x, producing a class xi with coefficients iY inverse image of G on YZ. Transport xi by the constant comparison. Apply the finite constant-coefficient killing theorem to iY:YZ to Y, giving a finite surjective locally finitely presented pi:Yprime to Y whose base change kills the transported class.
Naturality of cohomological pullback and injectivity of cohomology maps of isomorphisms remove the constant comparisons and show that the pullback of xi itself is zero.

Paste the cartesian squares for f and pi. Unit/edge compatibility identifies the image of x under the pushed-forward abelian unit, after finite exchange and the finite edge map for the composite, with the zero pullback of xi. Exchange and edge maps are injective; cancel them and then the direct-image composition isomorphism. The pushed-forward abelian unit therefore kills x.

Let a be the abelian adjunct of the forgotten module unit U(eta_module). The adjunction bijection gives eta_ab followed by pi_*a = U(eta_module). Push this equality forward by f, restrict by i, and apply H. The first factor kills x; the second factor sends zero to zero. Hence the pushed-forward module unit kills x.

theorem exists_finite_cover_pushforward_unit_closed_cohomology_eq_zero
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsFinite f]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) [Finite M] (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (x : Sheaf.H (((i)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj
      ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
        ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj
          ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)))) q) :
    ∃ (Y' : Scheme.{u}) (π : Y' ⟶ Y),
      IsFinite π ∧ Surjective π ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation π ∧
        Sheaf.H.map (((i)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).map
          ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).map
            ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).map
              ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) π).unit.app
                ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)))))
          q x = 0
